title: Quiz: Profiling in Python: How to Find Performance Bottlenecks
description: Check how well you can find performance bottlenecks in Python with time, timeit, cProfile, Pyinstrument, and the Linux perf profiler.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Profiling in Python: How to Find Performance Bottlenecks . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit why you should profile before you optimize, how to measure real and CPU time with time and timeit , and how deterministic profilers like cProfile compare to statistical ones like Pyinstrument.
takeaways: With these tools in your kit, you’ll be able to back up your optimization decisions with real data instead of guesswork.
